reply: With 20 minutes, do a simple full-body session: 3 minutes of warm-up, then 2–3 rounds of 10 squats, 8–12 push-ups (use an incline or knees if needed), 10 alternating reverse lunges, and 20–30 seconds of plank. Rest 30–45 seconds between rounds, then use the final 2 minutes to cool down. Keep the effort steady and stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath.
